title: WB Primary TET 2023 — Official Question Paper
description: West Bengal Board of Primary Education (WBBPE) Teacher Eligibility Test 2023 (Classes I–V). 150 compulsory questions across 5 sections (Bilingual English & Bengali).

instructions.en: The question paper contains 150 compulsory multiple choice questions across five parts of 30 questions each: Child Development & Pedagogy, Language I (Bengali), Language II (English), Mathematics, and Environmental Studies. Each correct answer carries +1 mark with no negative marking. Total time: 150 minutes.
